name: Lumsden Fire Tower
summary: Labelle Lake Peak once held the Lumsden fire tower; a May 2016 visit report found only its footings and rusted ski-lift remains.
status_note: A May 2016 visit report found only the tower's deteriorated footings and the rusted ski-lift remains on the summit.

access.note: The visit report describes a walk from Nelson Lake Road on a rough ATV trail. It says nothing about gates, closure or ownership.

visit.trail_note: Park where Nelson Lake Road turns rough; the ATV trail reaches the summit about 1.1 km from the road.

events.note: Visit report posted May 2016: the ski-lift remains were rusted and the tower's footings deteriorated.
